## Problem

What problem does this solve? What are you trying to do that's hard or impossible today?

## Alternatives considered

## Invariant check

claude-env has non-negotiable security guarantees (local-only, no network egress,
append-only audit ledger, policy-gated filesystem access — see CONTRIBUTING.md).
Does this proposal respect them? If it touches any of them, explain how.

Anything else — links, prior art, mockups.
